plain.li: I work better with one of these in me.
Just the one, and back to it.
[crafting] One cup, then to the bench.
[crafting] This is how the good pieces get made.
[construction] A sip before I raise the walls.
[mining] One for the dark of the mine.
[artistic] A cup to wake the eye before I carve.
[cooking] One for the cook before the pots.
[social] A drink first, then I'll talk them round.

cheerful.li: Cheers, now watch what these hands can do!

gloomy.li: Easier to face the work after one of these.

cold.li: It helps me learn, so I drink.
